$comment: Google's FIXED Parameters schema for the CX Agent Studio widget tool 'productCarousel' (Widget Type PRODUCT_CAROUSEL), captured verbatim from the live tool via the CES REST API on 2026-07-29. Nothing here is pasted into the console: typed widget tools (PRODUCT_CAROUSEL, PRODUCT_DETAILS) carry this Google-defined contract and the console's schema editor is read-only for them -- only the CUSTOM widget type accepts an author-defined schema. This file documents the contract the agent instructions map searchCatalog results onto: title<-name, subtitle<-designer, price<-price as a dollar string, productId<-the url slug, uri<-storefront base URL + url, imageUris<-[image]. See agent/instructions.md 'Rich response widgets' and docs/runbook.md.

productDetails.description: Required. An ordered list of products to be displayed.

imageUris.description: A list of direct URLs to images displaying the product.

price.description: The current selling price of the product.

productId.description: The unique identifier for this specific product.

uri.description: The URL directing users to the full product detail page.

subtitle.description: A longer, secondary line of text for additional context.

title.description: Required. The primary name of the product as listed.
